text: 你举手表示和平，外星生物却伸手去拿扭曲的金属装置。它们的嗡鸣升高到令人毛骨悚然的音调。你还要继续表达善意吗？

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 478
text: As you raise your hand in a peaceful gesture, the aliens grab for twisted metal devices. Their buzzing rises to a pitch that makes your skin crawl. Should you follow through on your peaceful intentions?
